notes.title: Update v.1.0.3
notes.content:
Based on the valuable feedback from you, our players, the following issues have been identified and resolved:


Identified and Fixed Issues:
Fixed the issue where doors and objects were not triggering properly during interactions.

FPS performance has been improved.

FPS limit options in the Settings menu have been updated.

Character stamina system has been optimized.

Trigger and animation issue in the final scene has been resolved.

notes.title: Interaction Issue Identified – Fix in Progress
notes.content:
🎮 Notice Regarding Interaction Issues


Dear players,



We've received your feedback and identified an issue where some players are unable to interact with certain elements in the game (such as opening doors or picking up objects). We understand how frustrating this can be and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.



🎯 Please rest assured that we are actively working on a fix and will release an update as soon as possible to resolve this issue.



✅ Once the fix is live, we will notify you through another announcement. Make sure to keep your game updated!



🛠 In the meantime, if you're experiencing any issues, feel free to share them on our Steam Community page or contact us at "interactivenightfall@gmail.com".



Thank you for your patience and support.
Happy gaming!


- Nightfall Interactive Development Team

notes.title: Update v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Camera Angle Adjustment System Added and Identified Bugs Fixed


New Feature
An adjustment option has been added for the camera's POV value.
Identified Bugs
Delay issues occurring during interactions have been fixed.

FPS optimization has been implemented.

The non-functional "Gamma" percentage setting in the settings menu has been removed and replaced with a notification displaying "Low" and "High" options.

notes.title: Update v.1.0.1
notes.content:
Thanks to your valuable feedback during the early access phase, we have addressed and fixed several gameplay-related issues.


Resolved Issues
The issue causing the game to end prematurely due to timing errors has been resolved. You can now enjoy a longer and more stable early access experience.

Animation glitches in the final scene have been fixed.

Glare problems on certain objects have been corrected.

FPS (frames per second) improvements have been made.
